_note: Schema reference. Each search supports: label (required), query (eBay search string), country (ISO code or list), seller (eBay username), must_contain (list of substrings — title must contain at least one, case-insensitive), exclude_keywords (list — drop if title contains any). Use must_contain to fight eBay's loose query expansion (e.g. 'Omega Seamaster 145.016' otherwise returns 145.029/145.024). Use exclude_keywords for seller-bait keywords (Zeitwerk/Calatrava prefixed Omegas) or modern variants of vintage refs. The example below filters at runtime (it lacks a real query/seller).
